title: [UE-0.6b] Restart-cycle smoke (after the MVP 5 card merges)
body:

Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `-SmokeRestartCycles=5` on a Development package logs `SMOKE_CYCLE n=I actors=N health=H load_ms=N` after each fail and restart, 5 lines in total (pasted)
- [ ] `tools\ue\smoke.ps1` with SMOKE_RESTART_CYCLES=5 prints PASS (pasted)

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

none
